text:
wish i could get these at a walmart/target, but still the best item to get any person who cares.. Came in good condition. A few "dents/knicks" in sharpening area after light use, but no other areas.

Better choice for most people considering what we all are looking for, cheap quality cutlery is achieved with most mercer products, this is my preferred brand for knives due to overall quality given the fact that we all have a tendency to replace rather than be zen masters. A great diamond steel will help keep a quality knife sharp especially if that knife can be replaced without great cost every few years, YEARS, proper treatment can give you a decade of use.

Money for value greatest investment for a knife, shallow angle regular swipes will help keep your cuts clean. Think a quarters distance for a 3" thick knife and a swipe or two on each side before use and after cleaning.

description: Maintain sharp edges on your cutlery with these high-performance steels. Diamond coated steels create a new bevel on the knife edge, leaving it razor sharp. Standard steels hone knives, removing burrs from knife edges. Mercer -- a company name highly regarded in the culinary trade -- is synonymous with quality, professional cutlery. A leader in the industry for more than 30 years and the predominant supplier to more than 90% of culinary academies in North America, Mercer brings you the finest tools used by the industry. World renowned Mercer has historically supplied culinary education and professional chefs, who have come to rely on the company for its distinct product offerings. As the culinary arts continue to gain popularity, Mercer's new product offerings have allowed the company to expand its brand and crossover into the consumer market. Ever-more-sophisticated home consumers are seeking the same products used by the professionals and Mercer products are not only high-quality professional grade, but with a distinct value advantage. The hallmark of Mercer Cutlery: exceptional quality in materials, unique design and dedicated craftsmanship, honed to the exacting performance needs of the discriminating chef, makes Mercer the undeniable choice for both the professional and the enthusiast.
